import-ap.remarks: EXPERIMENTAL export. No FedRAMP 20x Assessment Plan exists to import; OSCAL Assessment Results require an import-ap, so this is a self-reference placeholder. This document is a machine-readable convenience export of the SDR, is not validated against the NIST OSCAL schema here, and is not part of the native 20x submission. Do not treat it as a certified OSCAL AR.

results.title: Security Decision Record - assessment results view
